test_title: RRB Technician Grade III Official Paper (Held On: 23 Dec, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: If cosec 2θ = sec(θ - 30)°, then find the measure of θ (in degrees).
solution:
**Given:**

csc 2theta = sec (theta - 30^circ)

**Formula used:**

csc x = dfrac{1}{sin x}, sec x = dfrac{1}{cos x}

**Calculation:**

dfrac{1}{sin 2theta} = dfrac{1}{cos (theta - 30^circ)}
